name: git-workflows
description: Skills for commits and GitHub or GitLab change-request lifecycles.

interface.shortDescription: Commit and land Git changes safely.
interface.longDescription: Reusable Git workflows for creating Conventional Commits, preparing GitHub pull requests and GitLab merge requests, driving automated review feedback, selecting merge methods, and verifying post-merge cleanup.
defaultPrompt: Use $git-workflows:create-pr to prepare this branch and open its change request.
Use $git-workflows:address-pr-feedback to drive automated review feedback to resolution.
Use $git-workflows:merge-pr to merge this ready change request and clean up.
